description: Fetch a web page through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com) and return AI-parsed structured JSON instead of raw HTML (product details, article content, listings). If the page holds no structured data, the result says so (that call is not billed) - use fetch_html for the page itself.

url.description: The absolute URL to fetch and parse.

name: fetch_parsed
title: Fetch AI-parsed page data
